correctness.rationale: For graph P_3 square P_n, n=2..8, the exact source code generates every face (=matching) by selecting graph edges in increasing index while enforcing disjoint endpoints. The independent reconstruction generated all augmented face counts 22,131,823,5096,31687,196785,1222550 and the same paired critical faces; exhaustive oriented-Hasse DAG topological sorting for all seven widths verified acyclicity. At n=2..7, only critical dimensions n-1 with counts 2,5,9,16,31,55 remain after empty-face pairing. At n=8 the matching leaves one 8-cell and 95 seven-cells; independent signed boundary recursion gives exactly the five coefficients (2753634376,+1),(2755666018,+1),(36509401192,-1),(36542940232,+1),(36544987234,+1). Their gcd is one, and the primitive attaching map into a wedge of 95 S^7 leaves a wedge of 94 S^7. This establishes finite integral homotopy, not merely mod-2 Betti ranks; no extrapolation to n>=9 is made.
residual_risks: Finite classification only, no n>=9; high-width computation resource-heavy but performed exactly here.
